title: Dasaratha falls unconscious
introduction: Sumantra narrates the ghastly fate of Ayodhya, both its animate and inanimate beings. Dasaratha laments and soon falls unconscious.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये अयोध्याकाण्डे एकोनषष्टितमः सर्गः
Thus completes 59th Chapter of Ayodhya Kanda of the glorious Ramayana of Valmiki, the work of a sage and the oldest epic.

verses.devanagari:
मम तु अश्वा निवृत्तस्य न प्रावर्तन्त वर्त्मनि |
उष्णम् अश्रु विमुन्चन्तः रामे सम्प्रस्थिते वनम्
verses.iast:
mama tu aśvā nivṛttasya na prāvartanta vartmani |
uṣṇam aśru vimuncantaḥ rāme samprasthite vanam
verses.translation: "Rama having departed to the forest, horses on the return path however, shedding warm tears, did not proceed further on the way."

verses.devanagari:
उभाभ्याम् राज पुत्राभ्याम् अथ कृत्वा अहम् ज्ञलिम् |
प्रस्थितः रथम् आस्थाय तत् दुह्खम् अपि धारयन्
verses.iast:
ubhābhyām rāja putrābhyām atha kṛtvā aham GYalim |
prasthitaḥ ratham āsthāya tat duhkham api dhārayan
verses.translation: "I, on my part, offering salutation with joined palms to both the princes and keeping back from that grief, ascended the chariot and moved on."

verses.devanagari:
गुहा इव सार्धम् तत्र एव स्थितः अस्मि दिवसान् बहून् |
आशया यदि माम् रामः पुनः शब्दापयेद् इति
verses.iast:
guhā iva sārdham tatra eva sthitaḥ asmi divasān bahūn |
āśayā yadi mām rāmaḥ punaḥ śabdāpayed iti
verses.translation: "With the hope that I shall be called again by Rama, I stayed there along with Guha for three days."

verses.devanagari:
विषये ते महा राज माम व्यसन कर्शिताः |
अपि वृक्षाः परिम्लानः सपुष्प अन्कुर कोरकाः
verses.iast:
viṣaye te mahā rāja māma vyasana karśitāḥ |
api vṛkṣāḥ parimlānaḥ sapuṣpa ankura korakāḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, emperor! Even trees in your domain have withered, without giving flowers sprouts and buds, having emaciated due to Rama's separation."

glosses.meaning: having emaciated due to Rama's separation.

verses.devanagari:
उपतप्तोदका नद्यः पल्वलानि सरांसि च |
परिष्कुपलाशानि वनान्युपवनानि च
verses.iast:
upataptodakā nadyaḥ palvalāni sarāṃsi ca |
pariṣkupalāśāni vanānyupavanāni ca
verses.translation: "Rivers, pools and lakes were with hot water. Groves and gardens were with their leaves, parched up."

verses.devanagari:
न च सर्पन्ति सत्त्वानि व्याला न प्रसरन्ति च |
राम शोक अभिभूतम् तन् निष्कूजम् अभवद् वनम्
verses.iast:
na ca sarpanti sattvāni vyālā na prasaranti ca |
rāma śoka abhibhūtam tan niṣkūjam abhavad vanam
verses.translation: "Living beings are not moving. Wild animals too are not roaming around. That forest became silent, predominated by grief towards Rama."

verses.devanagari:
लीन पुष्कर पत्राः च नर इन्द्र कलुष उदकाः |
सम्तप्त पद्माः पद्मिन्यो लीन मीन विहम्गमाः
verses.iast:
līna puṣkara patrāḥ ca nara indra kaluṣa udakāḥ |
samtapta padmāḥ padminyo līna mīna vihamgamāḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, emperor! Lotus-lakes were with lotus-leaves hiding under water pressing themselves closely together, with muddy waters, with parched lotus-flowers and in which fish and water fowls have completely disappeared."

glosses.meaning: and in which fish and water-fowls having disappeared.

verses.devanagari:
जलजानि च पुष्पाणि माल्यानि स्थलजानि च |
न अद्य भान्ति अल्प गन्धीनि फलानि च यथा पुरम्
verses.iast:
jalajāni ca puṣpāṇi mālyāni sthalajāni ca |
na adya bhānti alpa gandhīni phalāni ca yathā puram
verses.translation: "Water-born flowers and flowers living on dry lands now give very little fragrance and fruits do not have a luscious look as before."

verses.devanagari:
अत्रोद्यानानि शून्यानि प्रलीनविहगानि च |
न चाभिरामानारामान् पश्यामि मनुजर्षभ
verses.iast:
atrodyānāni śūnyāni pralīnavihagāni ca |
na cābhirāmānārāmān paśyāmi manujarṣabha
verses.translation: "Oh, best of men! The gardens here are empty of men and the birds have vanished. I am not seeing the gardens as charming (as before)."

verses.devanagari:
प्रविशन्तम् अयोध्याम् माम् न कश्चित् अभिनन्दति |
नरा रामम् अपश्यन्तः निह्श्वसन्ति मुहुर् मुहुः
verses.iast:
praviśantam ayodhyām mām na kaścit abhinandati |
narā rāmam apaśyantaḥ nihśvasanti muhur muhuḥ
verses.translation: "Nobody greeted me, entering into Ayodhya City. Having not seen Rama, the people are breathing their sigh of lamentation again and again."

verses.devanagari:
देव राजरथम् दृष्ट्वा विना राममिहागतम् |
दुःखादश्रुमुखः सर्वो राजमार्गगतो जनः
verses.iast:
deva rājaratham dṛṣṭvā vinā rāmamihāgatam |
duḥkhādaśrumukhaḥ sarvo rājamārgagato janaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, emperor! Seeing the royal chariot returning here without Rama, all the people along the royal high-way are shedding tears with grief."

glosses.meaning: are having their faces filled with tears

verses.devanagari:
हर्म्यैः विमानैः प्रासादैः अवेक्ष्य रथम् आगतम् |
हाहा कार कृता नार्यो राम अदर्शन कर्शिताः
verses.iast:
harmyaiḥ vimānaiḥ prāsādaiḥ avekṣya ratham āgatam |
hāhā kāra kṛtā nāryo rāma adarśana karśitāḥ
verses.translation: "Seeing the returned chariot, women from mansions, seven-storied buildings and royal palaces are crying �ha ha!', being troubled by the non-appearance of Rama."

glosses.meaning: being troubled by non-appearance of Rama."

verses.devanagari:
आयतैः विमलैः नेत्रैः अश्रु वेग परिप्लुतैः |
अन्योन्यम् अभिवीक्षन्ते व्यक्तम् आर्ततराः स्त्रियः
verses.iast:
āyataiḥ vimalaiḥ netraiḥ aśru vega pariplutaiḥ |
anyonyam abhivīkṣante vyaktam ārtatarāḥ striyaḥ
verses.translation: "Women, being more sorrowful, are looking at each other indistinctly with their long bright eyes overwhelmed with a flood of tears."

glosses.meaning: overwhelmed with a flood of tears.

verses.devanagari:
न अमित्राणाम् न मित्राणाम् उदासीन जनस्य च |
अहम् आर्ततया कंचित् विशेषम् न उपलक्षये
verses.iast:
na amitrāṇām na mitrāṇām udāsīna janasya ca |
aham ārtatayā kaṃcit viśeṣam na upalakṣaye
verses.translation: "I do not see any distinction in their agony, whether they are non-friends, friends or neutral people."

verses.devanagari:
अप्रहृष्ट मनुष्या च दीन नाग तुरम्गमा |
आर्त स्वर परिम्लाना विनिह्श्वसित निह्स्वना
निरानन्दा महा राज राम प्रव्राजन आतुला |
कौसल्या पुत्र हीना इवायोध्या प्रतिभाति मा मा
verses.iast:
aprahṛṣṭa manuṣyā ca dīna nāga turamgamā |
ārta svara parimlānā vinihśvasita nihsvanā
nirānandā mahā rāja rāma pravrājana ātulā |
kausalyā putra hīnā ivāyodhyā pratibhāti mā mā
verses.translation: "Oh, emperor! The city of Ayodhya with its joy-less people, with its elephants and horses looking miserable, with sighing exhaustion due to cries of pain, filled with sounds of moaning, cheerless and feeling anguish due to Rama's exile, appears to me, like Queen Kausalya without her son."

glosses.meaning: with elephants and horses looking miserable
with sighing exhaustion to cries of pain

verses.devanagari:
सूतस्य वचनम् श्रुत्वा वाचा परम दीनया |
बाष्प उपहतया राजा तम् सूतम् इदम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
sūtasya vacanam śrutvā vācā parama dīnayā |
bāṣpa upahatayā rājā tam sūtam idam abravīt
verses.translation: Hearing Sumantra's words, the king in a voice choked with tears and very much woeful, spoke to that charioteer as follows:

verses.devanagari:
कैकेय्या विनियुक्तेन पाप अभिजन भावया |
मया न मन्त्र कुशलैः वृद्धैः सह समर्थितम्
verses.iast:
kaikeyyā viniyuktena pāpa abhijana bhāvayā |
mayā na mantra kuśalaiḥ vṛddhaiḥ saha samarthitam
verses.translation: "Enjoined by Kaikeyi with her sinful birth and intention, I could not deliberate with people experienced in counsel or with elders beforehand."

verses.devanagari:
न सुहृद्भिर् न च अमात्यैः मन्त्रयित्वा न नैगमैः |
मया अयम् अर्थः सम्मोहात् स्त्री हेतोह् सहसा कृतः
verses.iast:
na suhṛdbhir na ca amātyaiḥ mantrayitvā na naigamaiḥ |
mayā ayam arthaḥ sammohāt strī hetoh sahasā kṛtaḥ
verses.translation: "This act has been done by me in haste due to infatuation for the sake of a woman, without consulting with friends or ministers or with interpreters of sacred texts."

glosses.meaning: for the sake of a woman
or with interpreters of sacred texts.

verses.devanagari:
भवितव्यतया नूनम् इदम् वा व्यसनम् महत् |
कुलस्य अस्य विनाशाय प्राप्तम् सूत यदृच्चया
verses.iast:
bhavitavyatayā nūnam idam vā vyasanam mahat |
kulasya asya vināśāya prāptam sūta yadṛccayā
verses.translation: "Oh, Sumantra! This great calamity, surely, has come as an inevitable consequence or for the ruin of this race or accidentally."

verses.devanagari:
सूत यद्य् अस्ति ते किंचिन् मया अपि सुकृतम् कृतम् |
त्वम् प्रापय आशु माम् रामम् प्राणाः सम्त्वरयन्ति माम्
verses.iast:
sūta yady asti te kiṃcin mayā api sukṛtam kṛtam |
tvam prāpaya āśu mām rāmam prāṇāḥ samtvarayanti mām
verses.translation: Oh, sumantra! If at all I have done any favour to you, lead me fast to Rama. My vital spirits are hastening me."

verses.devanagari:
यद् यद् या अपि मम एव आज्ञा निवर्तयतु राघवम् |
न शक्ष्यामि विना राम मुहूर्तम् अपि जीवितुम्
verses.iast:
yad yad yā api mama eva āGYā nivartayatu rāghavam |
na śakṣyāmi vinā rāma muhūrtam api jīvitum
verses.translation: "If there is the same unlimited authority of mine even now, let Rama be brought back to Ayodhya. I cannot survive without Rama even for a moment."

glosses.meaning: if there is the same unlimited authority

verses.devanagari:
अथवा अपि महा बाहुर् गतः दूरम् भविष्यति |
माम् एव रथम् आरोप्य शीघ्रम् रामाय दर्शय
verses.iast:
athavā api mahā bāhur gataḥ dūram bhaviṣyati |
mām eva ratham āropya śīghram rāmāya darśaya
verses.translation: "Or perhaps Rama the mighty-armed might have gone a long way. Make me to ascend the chariot and quickly show me to Rama."

verses.devanagari:
वृत्त दम्ष्ट्रः महा इष्वासः क्व असौ लक्ष्मण पूर्वजः |
यदि जीवामि साध्व् एनम् पश्येयम् सह सीतया
verses.iast:
vṛtta damṣṭraḥ mahā iṣvāsaḥ kva asau lakṣmaṇa pūrvajaḥ |
yadi jīvāmi sādhv enam paśyeyam saha sītayā
verses.translation: "Where is that Rama having pearl-like teeth and wearing a large bow? If only I can see him well with Seetha, I can survive."

glosses.meaning: and wearing a large bow? Pashyeyam yadi = If I can see

verses.devanagari:
लोहित अक्षम् महा बाहुम् आमुक्त मणि कुण्डलम् |
रामम् यदि न पश्यामि गमिष्यामि यम क्षयम्
verses.iast:
lohita akṣam mahā bāhum āmukta maṇi kuṇḍalam |
rāmam yadi na paśyāmi gamiṣyāmi yama kṣayam
verses.translation: "If I cannot see Rama having red eyes, mighty arms and with ear-rings made of gems, I shall proceed to the world of Death."

verses.devanagari:
अतः नु किम् दुह्खतरम् यो अहम् इक्ष्वाकु नन्दनम् |
इमाम् अवस्थाम् आपन्नो न इह पश्यामि राघवम्
verses.iast:
ataḥ nu kim duhkhataram yo aham ikṣvāku nandanam |
imām avasthām āpanno na iha paśyāmi rāghavam
verses.translation: "What is more distressing to me after getting into this condition, in not seeing here, Rama who is a delight to Ikshvaku dynasty?"

glosses.meaning: who is a delight to Ikshvaku dynasty

verses.devanagari:
हा राम राम अनुज हा हा वैदेहि तपस्विनी |
न माम् जानीत दुह्खेन म्रियमाणम् अनाथवत्
verses.iast:
hā rāma rāma anuja hā hā vaidehi tapasvinī |
na mām jānīta duhkhena mriyamāṇam anāthavat
verses.translation: "Oh, Rama! Oh, Younger Brother of Rama! Oh, unfortunate Seetha! You do not know that I am dying with grief, like one abandoned."

verses.devanagari:
स तेन राजा दुःखेन भृशमर्पितचेतनः |
अवगाढः सुदुष्पारम् शोकसागमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
sa tena rājā duḥkhena bhṛśamarpitacetanaḥ |
avagāḍhaḥ suduṣpāram śokasāgamabravīt
verses.translation: King Dasaratha, his mind very much despaired with grief and plunged in an ocean of sorrow, very difficult to be crossed, spoke (as follows)

glosses.meaning: which is very difficult to be crossed

verses.devanagari:
रामशोकमहाभोगः सीताविरहपारगः |
श्वसितोर्मिमहावर्तो बाष्पफेनजलाविलः
बाहुविक्षेपमीनौघो विक्रन्दितमहास्वनः |
प्रकीर्णकेशशैवालः कैकेयीबडबामुखः
ममाश्रुवेगप्रभवः कुब्जावाक्यमहाग्रहः |
वरवेलो नृशंसाया रामप्रव्राजनायतः
यस्मिन् बत निमग्नोऽहम् कौसल्ये राघवम् विना |
दुस्तरः जीवता देवि मया अयम् शोक सागरः
verses.iast:
rāmaśokamahābhogaḥ sītāvirahapāragaḥ |
śvasitormimahāvarto bāṣpaphenajalāvilaḥ
bāhuvikśepamīnaugho vikranditamahāsvanaḥ |
prakīrṇakeśaśaivālaḥ kaikeyībaḍabāmukhaḥ
mamāśruvegaprabhavaḥ kubjāvākyamahāgrahaḥ |
varavelo nṛśaṃsāyā rāmapravrājanāyataḥ
yasmin bata nimagno'ham kausalye rāghavam vinā |
dustaraḥ jīvatā devi mayā ayam śoka sāgaraḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, Queen Kausalya! I am plunged in this ocean of grief. Its area of sorrow is for Rama. its other shore is Seetha's separation. Its waves and huge whirlpools are sighs of anguish. It is agitated with water and foam as tears. Throwing away of arms is the swarm of fishes. Its great sounds are cries of lamentation. The scattered hari is its duck-week. Kaikeyi is its submarine fire. Which is the cause for the rush in my tears. The words of the hum-backed are its huge crocodiles. Its shores are the boons asked by the cruel Kaikeyi. Its long stretch is due to sending of Rama to far away place. I cannot cross this ocean alive, without Rama. What a pity!"

glosses.meaning: its area of sorrow is for Rama
its waves and huge whirl-pools are sighs of anguish
It is agitated with water and foam as tears
throwing away of arms is the swarm of fishes
its great sounds are cries of lamentation
the scattered hair is its duck-weed. kaikeyiibaDabaamukhaH = Kaikeyi is its submarine fire
which is the cause for the rust in my tears
the words of the hump-backed are its huge crocodiles
its long stretch is due to sending of Rama to a far way place
It cannot be crossed jiivitaa = alive

verses.devanagari:
अशोभनम् यो अहम् इह अद्य राघवम् |
दिदृक्षमाणो न लभे सलक्ष्मणम्
इति इव राजा विलपन् महा यहाशः
पपात तूर्णम् शयने स मूर्चितः
verses.iast:
aśobhanam yo aham iha adya rāghavam |
didṛkṣamāṇo na labhe salakṣmaṇam
iti iva rājā vilapan mahā yahāśaḥ
papāta tūrṇam śayane sa mūrcitaḥ
verses.translation: "Though I want to see Rama and Lakshmana now, I am not able to see them here. It is very bad." - thus lamenting, the king of great renown soon became unconscious and fell down on his couch.

verses.devanagari:
इति विलपति पार्थिवे प्रनष्टे |
करुणतरम् द्विगुणम् च राम हेतोः |
वचनम् अनुनिशम्य तस्य देवी |
भयम् अगमत् पुनर् एव राम माता
verses.iast:
iti vilapati pārthive pranaṣṭe |
karuṇataram dviguṇam ca rāma hetoḥ |
vacanam anuniśamya tasya devī |
bhayam agamat punar eva rāma mātā
verses.translation: Hearing his words lamenting as much as twice more pitiably for Rama and the king having fallen unconscious, Kausalya was alarmed once again.
